newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli swordsmen invited to lock sabres in Iran.
newsitem.headline: Israeli swordsmen invited to lock sabres in Iran.

text.p: Verbal sparring between the Jewish state and the Islamic Republic of Iran may soon give way to the clash of swords.
Israel said its swordsmen have been invited to lock sabres at an international fencing tournament next month hosted by arch-enemy Iran.
"Looking forward to seeing you in Tehran," reads the invitation bearing the Islamic Republic's letterhead to Israeli fencing federation director Moshe Ben-Ezra.

Ben-Ezra told Reuters the letter, signed by 1997 Tehran International Fencing Championships Chairman M. Mohammad Zadeh, was delivered in an envelope of the Paris-based International Fencing Organisation.

However, Ben-Ezra said it was not clear if Israeli athletes would be let into Iran for the men's foil and sabre tournament to be held from February 12 to 14. Iran severed ties with the Jewish state after a 1979 Islamic revolution,
